prompt: What does the term "context rot" describe?

options.text: Cached prompts expiring after a few minutes.
Accuracy and recall degrading as the number of tokens in the context grows.
Old messages being deleted by the API when the window fills.
Tool definitions becoming outdated as APIs change.

explanation: Anthropic describes context rot as accuracy and recall degrading as token count grows. A larger window does not make more context automatically better, so curating what is in context matters as much as how much fits.

sources.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents (Anthropic)
